metadata.matched_init: each grid cell resets to the same deterministic init seed and applies the declared initialization; optimizer-family and initialization questions are kept separately interpretable (the alternative init is compared only under Adam)
metadata.statistical_discipline: Five frozen E checkpoints are the independent units; F is a control. The two readers are analysis-only, fit on Z/Y's exact fixed 256-transition subset, tuned on Y's canonical VAL, evaluated once on Y's untouched canonical TEST. Selection is VAL-only; the best-on-TRAIN state is diagnostic; TEST is never used to select a condition/reader/history.

primary_decision.rule_note: AB-INVALID if preflight/invariant fails, or the adam_ref GRU control is not robust at both histories, or adam_ref does not reproduce AA's Adam baseline; else AB-A if some condition is robust for the TCN at BOTH histories; else AB-MIX if robust at one history or mean>=0.90 without the 4/5-seed criterion; else AB-B. Robust = five-seed mean max-train >=0.90 AND >=4/5 seeds >=0.90.
